_comment: The server-driven sidebar menu. GET /spark/program-units filters this per caller before it
reaches the client, so a unit whose target the caller has no right to never appears -- hosts
write zero router links for navigation.
Home is a persistentObject unit with an objectId, which makes it a deep link to one page
(/po/home/main) rather than a list. The id is any stable string the app chooses; HomeActions
receives it as OnLoadAsync's id argument and ignores it -- there is exactly one Home.
There is deliberately NO url unit for the 'install the GitHub App' link. Its address is
per-environment (coveragedevelopment vs coverageproduction, resolved from configuration at
request time), and this file is static -- a hardcoded slug would point a developer's machine
at the production App. That link stays in the Angular extra content on the Home page, where
it comes from /api/me/accounts and is correct in every environment.
